answer: My answer to sybils is Proof of unique student enrolment history with education ministry attestation — enrolments the ministry recorded across school years — which makes the summit of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the relic is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The gale grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
